import os
import shutil

from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
from miniconf.loader import load

b = "_t"
os.makedirs(os.path.join(b, "sub"), exist_ok=True)
files = {
    "a.conf": "x = 1\n@include sub/b.conf\ny = 9\n",
    "sub/b.conf": "x = 2\ny = 3\n@include c.conf\n",
    "sub/c.conf": "z = 5\n",
    "d.conf": "@include e.conf\n",
    "e.conf": "@include d.conf\n",
    "m.conf": "@include nope.conf\n",
    "s.conf": "@include s.conf\n",
}
for name, text in files.items():
    with open(os.path.join(b, name), "w") as fh:
        fh.write(text)
try:
    cwd = os.getcwd()
    os.chdir("miniconf")
    c = load(os.path.join(cwd, b, "a.conf"))
    print(c.get("x"), c.get("y"), c.get("z"))
    for f in ["d", "m", "s"]:
        try:
            load(os.path.join(cwd, b, f + ".conf"))
            print("no error!")
        except ConfigError as e:
            print("ConfigError:", e)
finally:
    os.chdir(cwd)
    shutil.rmtree(b)
